products.desc:
خليط قوي من الزيوت والإضافات اللي ما تحتوي على أي مذيبات. مصمم لزيادة القوة وكفاءة استهلاك الوقود وتقليل انبعاثات العادم من خلال احتراق أكثر كمالاً.

معالج الوقود من لوكاس مخصصة لكل من محركات البنزين والديزل، سواء كانت كربريتور أو بنظام حقن الوقود. تعطي نظام الوقود ما يحتاجه فعلاً – مزيج من الزيوت الفائقة النعومة والإضافات مع عمل تنظيف عالي اللي يسمح للمحرك بالعمل بكفاءة قصوى. أيضاً، تنظف وتزيت المكربن والحاقنات وتجعل الوقود يحترق بشكل أكمل لزيادة القوة وتقليل استهلاك الوقود. معالجة الوقود من لوكاس يجب استخدامها بالتأكيد في السيارات اللي تحتاج لوقود يحتوي على الرصاص لأنها فعلاً تحل محل فوائد الرصاص في البنزين بدون ما تسبب انبعاثات ضارة. استخدمها لاجتياز اختبارات الانبعاثات. وأخيراً، تعادل تماماً الآثار الضارة لوقود الديزل منخفض الكبريت.

معالجة الوقود من لوكاس تتوافق مع متطلبات المحتوى المنخفض للكبريت الفيدرالية لاستخدامها في مركبات الديزل غير الطرقية، القاطرات، ومحركات معدات البحرية.

زيوت محركات لوكاس الاصطناعية API SP لسيارات الركاب (PCMO) مزيج من الزيوت الأساسية من أعلى جودة API Group III و Group IV، وتُدمج مع حزمة إضافات متطورة تشمل المنظفات والمشتتات ومضادات الأكسدة وموانع للتآكل. تعمل معدلات اللزوجة المستقرة على ضمان أداء متعدد الدرجات طوال عمر الزيت. مع وصول API SP/ILSAC GF-6 تأتي اختبارات جديدة لتأهيل زيوت المحرك وتقاعد بعض الاختبارات القديمة. بشكل محدد، يمكن ملاحظة الأداء المحسن في التحسينات التالية: الحفاظ على نظافة المكابس، التحكم في الأكسدة، منع تلوث زيت المحرك، حماية سلسلة التوقيت من التآكل، وفوائد في الاقتصاد في استهلاك الوقود. احمِ استثمارك واعتمد على زيت محرك لوكاس لسيارتك.

products.name: محسن الزيت البترولي
products.desc:
محسن الزيت البترولي نقي متعدد الاستخدامات. يتحكم في الصوت والحرارة والتآكل في نواقل الحركة اليدوية والدفرنسات. رقم واحد في المعدات الصناعية ومعدات الأعمال الشاقة والأداء العالي.

محسن زيت البترولي هو منتج بترولي 100% مصمم للقضاء على البدايات الجافة وتقليل الاحتكاك والحرارة والتآكل في أي نوع من المحركات. يعطي زيوت المحركات تزييت أعلى مما يقلل استهلاك الزيت وحرارة التشغيل. استخدم محسن زيت البترولي في ناقل الحركة اليدوي لإيقاف التسربات، وتقليل حرارة التشغيل وزيادة عمر زيت التروس. لأنه بترولي نقي، يمكن خلطه بأمان مع كل الزيوت الأخرى للسيارات، حتى الزيوت الصناعية، وزيت ناقل الحركة الآلي، والزيت المعدني. يحافظ على المحركات القديمة ويجعل المحركات الجديدة تبقى جديدة.

في محركات فورد باورستروك، نوصي باستخدام ربع جالون من مثبت الزيت الصناعي النقي مع كل تغيير زيت.

زيادة عمر الزيت بنسبة 50% على الأقل

products.name: معالج كامل المحرك
products.desc:
هي تركيبة فريدة تنظف وتزيت أنظمة متعددة في سيارتك. عند إضافتها للوقود، تنظف وتزيت جميع المكونات من خزان الوقود إلى الأسطوانات. تزيل الرواسب، تحمي من التآكل، وتساعد على احتراق الوقود بشكل أكثر كفاءة، مما يقلل من الانبعاثات، ويحسن من استهلاك الوقود، ويزيد من القوة. عند إضافتها لزيت المحرك، تنظف محركك وتكون حاجزاً واقياً ضد الحرارة والاحتكاك، تحسن تدفق الزيت في الطقس البارد وتطيل عمر الزيت. مناسبة لجميع أنواع المحركات والزيوت.

الفوائد الرئيسية:

عند إضافتها للوقود:

تنظف وتزيت كامل نظام الوقود من الخزان إلى الحاقنات.

تزيل الرواسب الضارة على صمامات السحب ورؤوس الأسطوانات.

تزيت جدران الأسطوانة العلوية وكذلك حلقات الضغط وحلقات الزيت.

تحتوي على إضافات خاصة من لوكاس تجعل الوقود يحترق بشكل كامل مما يقلل من انبعاثات العادم ويحسن استهلاك الوقود.

تعاكس تأثير التآكل الناتج عن الإيثانول في الوقود.

عند إضافتها لزيت المحرك:

تحسن نظافة المحرك وتقلل من الرواسب والصمغ، خاصة في المحركات التي تستهلك الزيت.

تقلل من الاحتكاك والتآكل.

تحسن سيولة الزيت في درجات الحرارة الباردة.

تساعد في إطالة عمر الزيت.

products.name: منظف الوصلات الكهربائية
products.desc:
بخاخ منظف الوصلات الكهربائية من لوكاس هو خليط فريد من المذيبات ومواد التنظيف ، مصمم لإزالة الزيت والأوساخ والرطوبة من نقاط التلامس في المعدات الكهربائية الصغيرة، أنظمة التحكم، أنظمة الإشعال، المحركات، المرحلات، والمنظمات الحرارية. هالتركيبة خالية من الكلور وCFC ومتوافقة مع معايير VOC، تجف بسرعة وما تترك أي بقايا.

بخاخ منظف الوصلات الكهربائية من لوكاس متوافق مع المعادن والمطاط. فعال جداً لتنظيف الأجزاء الكهربائية في الدبابات اللي تعرضت لكميات كبيرة من الزيت والأوساخ والحطام. لازم تكون حذر عند استخدامه حول البلاستيك.

مع إنه متوافق مع معظم المواد، الأفضل تجربته على منطقة صغيرة للتأكد من التوافق لما تستخدمه مع الأجزاء البلاستيكية.

الفوائد الرئيسية:

تركيبة تنظيف وتجفيف ممتازة

قيمة أفضل مقارنة بمنتجات المنافسين

products.short: تستخدم لوكاس مذيبات فائقة التحمل ومنظف مسدس بالموجات فوق الصوتية ويوصى به من قبل الشركات المصنعة للأسلحة النارية، وهو مزيج ممتاز من مذيبات التنظيف وموانع التآكل. يزيل بسهولة الكربون وبقايا المسحوق من الأعمال وكذلك النحاس وقاذورات الرصاص من الاسطوانات والبراميل. تنظف التركيبة القائمة على المذيبات بعمق لإزالة الزيوت والشحوم القديمة وتوفر طبقة رقيقة دقيقة من الصدأ ومانع التآكل على الأسطح المعدنية والمسام. إنه آمن على البوليمرات والأسلحة النارية المطبقة في المصنع.
products.desc:
يستخدم ويوصى به من قبل كبار مصنعي الأسلحة النارية، يعد مزيجًا مميزًا من المذيبات المنظفة موانع التآكل. يزيل بسهولة بقايا الكربون والبارود من الأجزاء الداخلية وكذلك الترسبات النحاسية والرصاص من الأسطوانات والسبطانات. الصيغة المعتمدة على المذيبات تنظف بعمق لإزالة الزيوت والشحوم القديمة وتوفر طبقة رقيقة من موانع الصدأ والتآكل على الأسطح المعدنية والسبطانات. آمن للاستخدام على البوليمرات والتشطيبات المطبقة على الأسلحة النارية من المصنع.

تم تصميمه أيضًا لتنظيف الأسلحة النارية بشكل كامل وفعال باستخدام أجهزة التنظيف بالأمواج فوق الصوتية، كما أن نقطة وميضه العالية تجعله مثاليًا للوحدات الحرارية. تمت صياغته بشكل خاص ليُستخدم مباشرة من الزجاجة في أجهزة التنظيف بالأمواج فوق الصوتية دون الحاجة إلى خلط مزعج أو استخدام عامل شطف أو غمر بالزيت، مما يوفر عليك الوقت والمال.

بعد التنظيف بالأمواج فوق الصوتية، ما عليك سوى إزالة السلاح، والسماح له بالجفاف بالتنقيط أو استخدام الهواء المضغوط، ثم قم بتزييته وفقًا لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة وأعد تركيبه. سيكون سلاحك نظيفًا ومحميًا من التآكل من الداخل والخارج، ومشحمًا وجاهزًا للتخزين أو الحمل أو الاستخدام.

الفوائد الرئيسية:

ينظف ويحمي أسلحتك النارية، ويوفر حماية ممتازة من الصدأ.

رائحة منخفضة، برائحة العنب اللطيفة، لا يحتوي على الأمونيا أو الكيروسين أو الماء.

رائع للاستخدام في أجهزة التنظيف بالأمواج فوق الصوتية، وصيغته القائمة على المذيبات لا تتطلب خلطًا، أو شطفًا، أو غمرًا بالزيت بعد الاستخدام، مما يوفر الوقت والمال.

مثالي للوحدات الحرارية، حيث تبلغ نقطة الوميض 210 درجة فهرنهايت مما يجعله أكثر أمانًا من المنتجات الأخرى.

Its wide 5W50 viscosity range supports dependable oil flow during cold starts while maintaining a durable protective film when engine temperatures climb under sustained high-RPM riding, towing, trail use, or competition.

Unlike standard automotive motor oil, VP 4T 5W50 is formulated for powersports engines with wet clutches. It maximizes engine power while maintaining the clutch friction needed for smooth, confident shifts without unwanted clutch slip.

Features and benefits

Full synthetic, ester-based formulation for protection in extreme temperatures

SAE 5W50 viscosity supports cold-start flow and high-temperature protection

Wet-clutch compatible for smooth shifting and durable clutch engagement

Hyper-ZDDP and anti-wear additives help extend engine life

Designed for motorcycles, dirt bikes, ATVs, and UTVs

Helps protect engines operated at high RPM and under sustained load

One-quart container

Compatible applications

VP 4T Full Synthetic SAE 5W50 is designed for four-stroke powersports equipment, including:

Street motorcycles

Dirt bikes

Dual-sport motorcycles

ATVs and four-wheelers

UTVs and side-by-sides

Other four-stroke powersports engines that specify SAE 5W50 oil

Always verify the viscosity and oil specification required in your equipment owner's manual before use.

Frequently asked questions

Is VP 4T 5W50 safe for wet-clutch motorcycles and ATVs?

Yes. VP 4T Full Synthetic SAE 5W50 is formulated for powersports engines with wet clutches. It maintains durable clutch friction for smooth shifting while providing ester-based full synthetic protection and Hyper-ZDDP anti-wear protection.

Can I use VP 4T 5W50 in my ATV or UTV?

Yes, if your owner's manual specifies SAE 5W50 engine oil. VP 4T 5W50 is designed for four-stroke ATVs, UTVs, motorcycles, and dirt bikes operating in demanding conditions.

Why should I use powersports oil instead of automotive oil?

Many motorcycles, dirt bikes, ATVs, and UTVs use a shared engine, transmission, and wet-clutch oil system. Automotive oil may contain friction modifiers that are not designed for wet clutches and can contribute to clutch slip. VP 4T 5W50 is formulated specifically to protect the engine while maintaining the friction characteristics a wet clutch needs.

What does 5W50 mean?

The 5W rating describes how the oil flows during colder starts, while the 50 indicates its viscosity protection at operating temperature. This wide viscosity range makes 5W50 a strong choice for powersports engines that experience large temperature swings or sustained high-load operation, provided the manufacturer recommends it.

Does VP 4T 5W50 work in dirt bikes?

Yes. VP 4T 5W50 is designed for four-stroke dirt bikes and other powersports engines that require SAE 5W50 oil. Its full synthetic, ester-based formulation is built for the high RPM, heat, and load common in off-road riding.

When should I change my powersports engine oil?

Follow the service interval in your owner's manual. Shorten the interval if the machine sees racing, extended high-RPM riding, heavy towing, deep mud, high heat, or other severe operating conditions.

products.name: VP Racing Frosty Clean Cooling System Cleaner & Flush
cats: Fuel Additives for Gas and Diesel
products.desc:
VP Racing Frosty Clean Cooling System Cleaner & Flush is a professional-grade formula that removes sediment, gels, and acidic buildup from automotive and performance cooling systems.

Over time, water hardness, antifreeze inhibitors, and glycol breakdown can leave deposits that restrict coolant flow and reduce heat transfer. Frosty Clean helps clear this buildup to restore cooling-system efficiency before adding fresh coolant or a cooling-system additive.

Its pH-neutral formula is designed to protect sensitive aluminum components while helping neutralize acidic contaminants that can contribute to corrosion and long-term cooling-system damage. Frosty Clean also lubricates the water pump to support smoother operation during the cleaning process.

Use Frosty Clean before installing VP Racing Stay Frosty coolant or adding VP Racing Cool Down coolant additive. One bottle treats cooling systems with capacities from 
12 to 22 quarts
.

Features and benefits

Professional-grade cooling system cleaner and flush

Removes gels and sediment caused by water hardness and antifreeze inhibitors

Helps neutralize acidic buildup associated with glycol breakdown

Prepares the cooling system for fresh coolant or coolant additive

pH-neutral formula helps protect sensitive aluminum components

Lubricates the water pump during the flush process

Supports cleaner coolant passages and more efficient heat transfer

One bottle treats cooling systems from 12 to 22 quarts

Recommended before using VP Racing Stay Frosty coolant or Cool Down coolant additive

Directions

1. Cool and drain the system

Make sure the engine is off and completely cool. Drain the existing coolant into an appropriate container, then close the radiator drain valve. Dispose of old coolant according to local regulations.

2. Add Frosty Clean

Pour the entire bottle of VP Racing Frosty Clean into the radiator. Fill the system with water and reinstall the radiator cap.

3. Circulate the cleaner

Start the engine, set the heater to high, and run the engine for 10 to 15 minutes.

4. Drain and flush

Shut off the engine and allow it to cool. Drain the system, refill with clean water, and run the engine again for 10 to 15 minutes.

5. Complete the final flush

Repeat as needed until the drained water is clear and free of sediment or suds. Refill the system with the appropriate VP Racing coolant or coolant additive.

Frequently asked questions

What does VP Racing Frosty Clean remove?

Frosty Clean helps remove gels and sediment caused by water hardness and antifreeze inhibitors. It also helps neutralize acidic buildup associated with glycol breakdown.

When should I use Frosty Clean?

Use Frosty Clean when servicing the cooling system, changing coolant, or before adding VP Racing Stay Frosty coolant or Cool Down coolant additive. Cleaning the system first helps prepare coolant passages for efficient performance.

How much cooling system capacity does one bottle treat?

One bottle of VP Racing Frosty Clean treats cooling systems with capacities from 
12 to 22 quarts
.

Is Frosty Clean safe for aluminum cooling-system components?

Yes. Frosty Clean uses a pH-neutral formula designed to help protect sensitive aluminum components in modern cooling systems.

Does Frosty Clean replace coolant?

No. Frosty Clean is a cleaning and flushing product, not a replacement coolant. Drain and flush the system after use, then refill it with the correct coolant or cooling-system additive for the application.

How long should I run Frosty Clean in the cooling system?

After adding Frosty Clean and water, run the engine with the heater on high for 10 to 15 minutes. Allow the engine to cool before draining and flushing the system with clean water.

Do I need to flush the system after using Frosty Clean?

Yes. Drain the cleaner and flush the system with clean water until the drained water is clear and free of sediment or suds before adding fresh coolant.

What does VP Speed Sauce do?

products.name: VP Racing Stay Frosty Race Ready Coolant
products.desc:
VP Stay Frosty Race Ready Coolant: Glycol-Free Racing Coolant for High-Heat Engines

VP Stay Frosty Race Ready is a 100% water-based, glycol-free racing coolant built for high-compression, high-heat competition engines. It reduces engine temperatures by up to 30°F and up to 80°F at the cylinder heads compared to conventional glycol-based coolants. It is ready to use straight from the container, track-approved at facilities that prohibit glycol, and formulated with the only three-wetting-agent system available in any racing coolant.

Why three wetting agents matter

Most racing coolants use a single surfactant. Stay Frosty Race Ready uses three, each operating at a different cloud point: low, middle, and high. That layered approach means the coolant maintains effective heat transfer across a wider temperature range. When engine temps spike past where a single-agent coolant stops working, Stay Frosty keeps pulling heat away from the cylinder heads.

The result is stable, advanced ignition timing without detonation risk, which is where the power gain comes from. Cooler cylinder heads mean denser air-fuel mix, more timing, and more torque.

Why glycol-free matters on track

Glycol is slippery. A coolant leak at speed creates a serious hazard for every other competitor on track. Most sanctioned racing organizations prohibit glycol-based coolants for this reason. Stay Frosty contains no glycol and is approved for use at drag strips, road courses, oval tracks, and off-road events where glycol is banned.

How to use it

Before using Stay Frosty for the first time, flush your cooling system with VP Frosty Clean Cooling System Flush to remove any glycol residue and optimize heat transfer performance. Then pour Stay Frosty Race Ready directly into the system. No mixing required.

Features

Reduces engine temps up to 30°F, up to 80°F at cylinder heads

Only racing coolant with 3 wetting agents

100% water-based, blended with reverse osmosis water

Glycol-free, track-approved

Ready to use, no mixing required

Non-toxic and biodegradable

No freeze protection (racing use only)

Available in:
 64oz and 1 Gallon

NOTE:
 Before using Stay Frosty for the first time, we recommend using 
Frosty Clean Cooling System Flush
 
to optimize your cooling system's efficiency and maximize Stay Frosty's performance.

 to help maximize coolant performance.

Features and benefits

Ready-to-use premixed high-performance engine coolant

No additional water required

Propylene glycol formula

Contains wetting agents to support heat transfer

Reduces operating temperatures by up to 14°F compared with traditional glycol-based coolants

Provides freeze protection down to 0°F

Available in 64-ounce and 1-gallon sizes

Frequently asked questions

What is VP Racing Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant?

Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant is a ready-to-use propylene glycol coolant formulated for high-performance engines. It contains heat-transfer agents and wetting agents designed to help move heat away from hot cylinder heads.

Does Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant need to be mixed with water?

No. Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant is a ready-to-use premix. Pour it directly into the cooling system without adding water.

How much can Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant reduce engine temperatures?

Testing has shown that the Hi-Performance formula can reduce operating temperatures by as much as 14°F compared with traditional glycol-based coolants. Actual results depend on the engine, cooling system, ambient conditions, and vehicle setup.

What is the freeze protection rating?

Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant provides freeze protection down to 0°F. Do not add additional additives or alter the premixed formula.

Does Stay Frosty protect against corrosion?

Yes. The coolant includes an OAT corrosion inhibitor designed to help protect aluminum and other metals from corrosion and electrolysis. Its formulation also helps prevent scale and deposits that can interfere with heat transfer.

What is the difference between Stay Frosty Hi-Performance and Stay Frosty Race Ready?

Stay Frosty Hi-Performance is a propylene glycol coolant that provides freeze protection down to 0°F. Stay Frosty Race Ready is a separate water-based, glycol-free racing coolant with no freeze protection. Choose the formula that matches your vehicle, track requirements, and operating conditions.

How often should Stay Frosty Hi-Performance Coolant be changed?

VP Racing recommends changing the coolant every two years. Always inspect the cooling system and follow the vehicle or engine manufacturer's service recommendations.

Should I flush my cooling system before using Stay Frosty?

Yes. VP Racing recommends using Frosty Clean Cooling System Flush before the first application of Stay Frosty to help clean the cooling system and maximize coolant performance.

products.name: VP Racing Cool Down Coolant Additive
cats: Fuel Additives for Gas and Diesel
products.desc:
VP Racing Cool Down is a coolant additive for gas and diesel engines that works with antifreeze, modern OAT and HOAT coolants, or straight-water cooling systems. Its advanced formula reduces coolant surface tension to improve coolant flow and heat transfer through the engine and radiator.

Cool Down helps lower coolant temperatures by up to 
30°F
 and cylinder head temperatures by up to 
75°F
, helping high-demand engines manage heat more effectively. It also lubricates water pumps and seals while helping protect all cooling-system metals, including aluminum, from corrosion and electrolysis.

Use VP Cool Down in street vehicles, race cars, trucks, RVs, towing applications, diesel engines, and powersports equipment. The formula also includes dispersants that help prevent sludge and deposits, supporting a cleaner and more efficient cooling system.

One 16-ounce bottle treats cooling systems from 
12 to 20 quarts
. Before the first use, clean the system with VP Racing Frosty Clean Cooling System Cleaner & Flush to help maximize Cool Down performance.

Features and benefits

Coolant additive for gas and diesel engines

Compatible with coolant, antifreeze, OAT and HOAT coolants, or straight-water systems

Helps reduce coolant temperatures by up to 30°F

Helps reduce cylinder head temperatures by up to 75°F

Improves coolant flow and heat transfer

Lubricates water pumps and seals

Helps protect cooling-system metals, including aluminum, from corrosion and electrolysis

Helps prevent sludge and deposits

Meets and exceeds ASTM D3306 specifications

One 16-ounce bottle treats 12 to 20 quarts of coolant

Suitable for racing, street vehicles, RVs, towing, diesel, and powersports applications

Directions

Make sure the engine is cool before removing the radiator cap.

Add Cool Down directly to the radiator when possible, or add it to the coolant reservoir according to the application ratio.

Start the engine, set the heater to high, and run the vehicle for 10 minutes to circulate the additive.

For street-driven vehicles with air conditioning, maintain at least 15% antifreeze in the cooling system.

Frequently asked questions

What does VP Racing Cool Down do?

VP Racing Cool Down is a coolant additive that improves heat transfer by reducing coolant surface tension. It helps lower operating temperatures, supports coolant flow, lubricates water pumps and seals, and helps protect the cooling system from corrosion and electrolysis.

Can I use VP Cool Down with antifreeze?

Yes. Cool Down works with antifreeze and is formulated for use with today's OAT and HOAT engine coolants. When used as directed, it should not disrupt the freeze protection provided by glycol-based antifreeze.

How much VP Cool Down should I use?

One 16-ounce bottle treats cooling systems holding 12 to 20 quarts. For coolant systems over 20 quarts, add one ounce of Cool Down for each additional quart.

How much should I use in a straight-water cooling system?

For full corrosion protection in a straight-water system, use 50% more Cool Down. VP Racing recommends using reverse-osmosis water labeled as purified drinking water for best results.

Can I use Cool Down in a diesel engine?

Yes. Cool Down is suitable for diesel engines. For full protection of wet sleeve cylinder liners in diesel applications, use twice the standard amount.

Can I use Cool Down in powersports equipment?

Yes. For powersports applications, use 
2 ounces of Cool Down per quart of coolant
.

How often should I add VP Cool Down?

Add one pint every year or every 30,000 miles. After the fifth consecutive year of use, drain, flush, and refill the cooling system.

Does Cool Down replace antifreeze?

No. Cool Down is an additive, not a replacement for antifreeze or coolant. It can be used with a coolant mixture or with straight water in applications where straight water is appropriate.

products.name: VP Racing Ultra Power™ Red Coolant: 50/50 Antifreeze Coolant for Heavy Duty Engines
products.desc:
VP Racing Ultra Power Red 50/50 Antifreeze Coolant is a ready-to-use coolant formulated for heavy-duty diesel engines in semi trucks, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and other demanding applications.

This prediluted 50/50 formula uses nitrited hybrid organic acid technology, also known as NOAT/HOAT, to deliver long-lasting cooling-system protection. It helps protect key system metals, including steel, aluminum, cast iron, copper, brass, and solder, from corrosion and electrolysis.

Ultra Power Red is engineered to help protect diesel engine wet sleeve cylinder liners from pitting and cavitation. These conditions can damage liners over time, cause unplanned downtime, and increase maintenance costs. Its advanced inhibitor package supports longer service intervals and reliable cooling-system performance in hard-working equipment.

The formula is premixed and ready to pour directly from the bottle. No mixing is required. When used as directed, VP Ultra Power Red provides protection for up to

.

Frequently asked questions

What is VP Ultra Power Red 50/50 Antifreeze Coolant designed for?

VP Ultra Power Red is formulated for heavy-duty diesel engines used in semi trucks, construction machinery, agricultural equipment, and other industrial applications that require dependable long-life cooling-system protection.

Does VP Ultra Power Red need to be mixed with water?

No. It is a prediluted 50/50 antifreeze coolant that is ready to pour directly into the cooling system. Do not add water unless specifically instructed by the equipment manufacturer.

What does NOAT/HOAT coolant mean?

NOAT stands for nitrited organic acid technology, while HOAT stands for hybrid organic acid technology. VP Ultra Power Red uses this inhibitor technology to help protect cooling-system metals and wet sleeve cylinder liners in heavy-duty diesel engines.

How does VP Ultra Power Red help protect wet sleeve liners?

Its nitrited inhibitor package helps protect wet sleeve cylinder liners from pitting and cavitation. These forms of damage can occur in heavy-duty diesel engines when repeated vibration and pressure changes affect the coolant side of the liner.

What metals does VP Ultra Power Red protect?

VP Ultra Power Red helps protect common cooling-system metals, including steel, aluminum, cast iron, copper, brass, and solder, from corrosion and electrolysis.

How long does VP Ultra Power Red last?

When used as directed, VP Ultra Power Red provides cooling-system protection for up to
 
six years or 600,000 miles
. Follow the service guidance from your engine or equipment manufacturer.

Can I use this coolant in construction or agricultural equipment?

Yes. VP Ultra Power Red is formulated for heavy-duty diesel applications, including construction and agricultural equipment, as well as semi trucks and industrial machinery.

Why use a heavy-duty coolant instead of a standard automotive coolant?

Heavy-duty diesel engines can require additional protection against wet sleeve liner pitting and cavitation. VP Ultra Power Red is formulated specifically to address those needs while also helping protect cooling-system metals from corrosion.

cats: Best Synthetic Oils For Diesel Trucks
products.desc:
VP 622 Racing Brake Fluid is a full synthetic DOT 4 fluid engineered for high-performance and competition braking applications. Its 622°F dry boiling point and 410°F wet boiling point exceed DOT 4 minimums by a significant margin, providing the thermal headroom needed to prevent vapor lock and brake fade under sustained hard braking conditions.

Brake fade caused by fluid boiling is one of the most dangerous failure modes in performance driving. When brake fluid reaches its boiling point, it vaporizes and creates compressible gas bubbles in the lines. The result is a soft, spongy pedal that provides reduced stopping force at exactly the moment you need it most. VP 622 is formulated to stay liquid and maintain a firm pedal through repeated hard stops on track.

Features & Benefits

622°F dry boiling point exceeds DOT 4 minimums for maximum fade resistance

410°F wet boiling point maintains performance even after moisture absorption

Full synthetic formula for consistent viscosity across temperature extremes

Protects seals, hoses, and metal brake components from corrosion

Applications

VP 622 is suited for:

Road racing and endurance racing

Track days and high-performance driving events

Autocross and time attack

High-performance street vehicles with upgraded brake systems

Any application requiring DOT 4 fluid with maximum fade resistance

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the boiling point of VP 622 Racing Brake Fluid?
 VP 622 has a dry boiling point of 622°F (328°C) and a wet boiling point of 410°F (210°C). Both exceed DOT 4 minimum requirements. The dry boiling point applies to fresh, uncontaminated fluid. The wet boiling point reflects performance after moisture absorption, which occurs naturally over time in any glycol-based brake fluid.

Is VP 622 compatible with my stock brake system?
 Yes. VP 622 is compatible with all DOT 3 and DOT 4 brake systems, including vehicles equipped with ABS, traction control, and stability control. Do not use in DOT 5 (silicone-based) systems.

How often should I change VP 622 Racing Brake Fluid?
 For track use, change the fluid before each race season or every 2 years, whichever comes first. Glycol-based brake fluids absorb moisture over time, which lowers the wet boiling point. For heavy track use, inspect and change more frequently.

Can I mix VP 622 with my existing DOT 4 fluid?
 Yes. VP 622 is compatible with other DOT 3 and DOT 4 fluids. However, mixing fluids will dilute the performance characteristics of VP 622. For best results, flush the system completely before filling with VP 622.

Why does wet boiling point matter?
 All glycol-based brake fluids absorb moisture from the atmosphere over time. Moisture lowers the boiling point of the fluid. The wet boiling point reflects performance after moisture absorption, which is the real-world condition your fluid operates in after months of use. VP 622's 410°F wet boiling point keeps performance high even as the fluid ages.

Why is X85L leaded?
 The leaded formula in X85L provides additional detonation protection beyond what the ethanol content alone delivers. For high-compression engines in classes where leaded fuel is permitted, the lead additive raises the effective octane ceiling and reduces the risk of detonation under extreme load.

What is the difference between VP X85L and VP X85?
 X85L is the leaded version of the X85 formula. Both are blended to the same 85% ethanol and 15% hydrocarbon specification and are consistent drum to drum. X85L adds a lead additive for additional detonation protection and achieves MON and RON both greater than 120. X85 is unleaded with a MON of 95.2 and RON of 108. Use X85L when your class rules permit leaded fuel and you need maximum octane protection.

What is the difference between VP X85L and VP C85?
 C85 is an unleaded ethanol fuel with a different base formulation, a RON of 106, and a lower stoichiometric A/F ratio of 9.20, suited for maximum-power drag and circle track applications.  Yes. X85L is a flammable liquid subject to hazmat regulations. A surcharge will be added at checkout and reflected in your shipping cost.

Brass synchronizers, bronze thrust washers, copper bushings, and similar soft metal components are common in vintage American and import manual gearboxes, and they require a GL4 specification oil to stay protected.

 GL5 gear oils contain higher concentrations of extreme pressure additives, specifically sulfur-phosphorus compounds, that can chemically attack yellow metals over time. Using GL5 in a transmission designed for GL4 can cause synchronizer degradation, rough shifting, and accelerated wear. Saginaw 3- and 4-speed

Rockwell manual transmissions

Maintains gear cleanliness for consistent shift quality

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between GL4 and GL5 gear oil?
 GL5 contains higher concentrations of sulfur-phosphorus extreme pressure additives that can chemically attack yellow metals like brass, bronze, and copper. Most classic American and import manual transmissions use these metals in synchronizers, thrust washers, and bushings. GL4 provides the right protection level for those components without the damaging chemistry. Always match the oil specification to what your transmission manufacturer requires.

Can I use VP Classic GL4 in a differential?
 No. This product is formulated for manual transmissions and transaxles requiring GL4. Do not use it in applications requiring GL5 extreme pressure gear oil, limited slip differentials, or any application calling for an OEM specialized lubricant.

What transmissions is VP Classic GL4 compatible with?
 It is recommended for Muncie, Borg-Warner, Ford Toploader, Saginaw, and Rockwell manual transmissions, as well as import manual transmissions and transaxles specifying GL4 gear oil.

Is VP Classic GL4 safe for synchronizers?
 Yes. The GL4 specification is specifically chosen to protect synchronizers made from yellow metals, which are common in classic manual transmissions. GL5 oils can damage these components over time.

What is VP Fix-It-Fuel?

VP Fix-It-Fuel is a ready-to-use, ethanol-free small engine treatment fuel that helps clean and rejuvenate fuel systems affected by old gasoline and ethanol-related damage.

Is Fix-It-Fuel a fuel additive?

Fix-It-Fuel helps address fuel-system problems associated with stale gasoline and ethanol-blended pump gas, including hard starts, rough running, carburetor deposits, injector deposits, and corrosion-related fuel-system issues.

Is Fix-It-Fuel good for equipment that has been stored?

Yes. Fix-It-Fuel can be used to help recover equipment after storage and provides off-season storage protection.

What should I use after Fix-It-Fuel has helped restore my equipment?

Use the VP Small Engine Fuel that matches your equipment's requirements, such as VP 4-Cycle Fuel, VP 40:1 Fuel Mix, VP 50:1 Fuel Mix, or VP Multi-Mix.

products.name: VP Racing 4-Cycle Fuel: Ethanol-Free Small Engine Fuel
products.desc:
VP 4-Cycle Fuel is a 94 octane, ethanol-free fuel formulated specifically for 4-cycle small engines. Pump gas with ethanol attracts moisture, forms varnish deposits, and clogs carburetors, especially in equipment that sits between seasons. VP 4-Cycle Fuel eliminates that problem entirely. It stays stable for 2 years in the tank and 5 years sealed in the can, so your mower, generator, or snow blower starts when you need it, not after a carburetor rebuild.

Formulated with higher-grade base stocks by the same team that has been building world-class racing fuels for over 50 years.

Features & Benefits

94 octane, ethanol-free formula prevents corrosion, gumming, and varnish buildup

Stable 2 years in-tank, 5 years sealed in the original container

Eliminates the need for fuel stabilizers

Passes warranty requirements for all major 4-cycle engine manufacturers

Blended specifically for small engine carburetors, not adapted from automotive fuel

Contains no oil, ready to pour

Made in the USA

Compatible Equipment

VP 4-Cycle Fuel works in any 4-cycle outdoor power equipment, including:

Lawn mowers (push and riding)

Generators

Snow blowers

Pressure washers

Tillers and cultivators

Riding equipment

Compatible Engine Brands

Briggs & Stratton, Kawasaki, Kohler, Honda, and more.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does VP 4-Cycle Fuel replace a fuel stabilizer?
 Yes. Because VP 4-Cycle Fuel is ethanol-free and formulated with high-grade base stocks, it remains stable for 2 years in the tank and 5 years in the sealed container without any added stabilizer. You do not need to add STA-BIL or similar products when using VP 4-Cycle Fuel.

Is VP 4-Cycle Fuel safe for all 4-cycle engines?
 Yes. It passes the warranty requirements of all major 4-cycle engine manufacturers, including Briggs & Stratton, Kawasaki, Kohler, and Honda. It contains no oil and is compatible with all 4-cycle outdoor power equipment.

Why is ethanol bad for small engines?
 Ethanol is hygroscopic, meaning it absorbs moisture from the air. In small engine carburetors, that moisture accumulates in the float bowl, causing rust, corrosion, and gummy deposits that clog jets and prevent starting. Equipment that sits for weeks or months between uses is especially vulnerable. Ethanol-free fuel eliminates this failure mode entirely.

Can I use VP 4-Cycle Fuel in a 2-cycle engine?
 No. VP 4-Cycle Fuel contains no oil and is not suitable for 2-cycle engines, which require a premixed oil-and-fuel blend. For 2-cycle equipment, use VP's 50:1 Fuel Mix.

What sizes does VP 4-Cycle Fuel come in?
 VP 4-Cycle Fuel is available in 1 quart, 1 gallon, 2.5 gallon pail, 5 gallon pail, and 54 gallon drum.

Frequently Asked Questions

What compression ratio can VP 110 support?
 VP 110 is formulated for naturally aspirated engines with compression ratios up to 12:1. If your build exceeds that, consider stepping up to a higher-octane VP fuel matched to your specific compression and induction setup.

Is VP 110 leaded or unleaded?
 VP 110 is a leaded fuel. It is not compatible with catalytic converters or oxygen sensors. It is intended for dedicated race vehicles only.

Can VP 110 be used in two-stroke engines?
 Yes. VP 110 works well in modified two-stroke applications and is commonly used as a standalone fuel or blended with pump gas in ratios from 25/75 to 50/50 for mildly modified two-stroke engines.

How long can VP 110 be stored?
 VP 110 has an oxidation stability rating of 1440+ minutes, indicating excellent shelf life. For best results, store in a sealed container away from heat and direct sunlight.

What is the difference between MON and RON?
 MON (Motor Octane Number) measures knock resistance under high-load, high-temperature conditions that closely simulate actual race engine operating conditions. RON (Research Octane Number) is measured under milder conditions. The pump rating (R+M)/2 is the average of both. For racing applications, MON is the more meaningful number because it reflects real-world detonation behavior under load.

What is VP C11 race fuel?

VP C11 is a leaded race fuel with a 109.5 (R+M)/2 octane rating, formulated for lower-compression drag racing engines. It is a dominant fuel in NHRA Stock and Super Stock class elimination and delivers more horsepower and torque than 110 and 112 fuel types for engines in that compression range.

Why does C11 outperform 110 and 112 fuels in lower-compression engines?

Higher-octane fuels are formulated for engines operating under higher cylinder pressure and heat. In a lower-compression engine, using a fuel matched to the engine's actual compression range can produce more complete combustion and more usable power. C11 is formulated for that application.

What is the difference between VP C11 and VP C12?

C12 has a higher octane rating of 119 (R+M)/2 and is designed for higher-compression engines and more demanding applications. C11 has a 109.5 (R+M)/2 rating and is formulated for lower-compression NHRA Stock and Super Stock engines, where additional octane is not necessarily beneficial.

products.desc:
Waxing is the single most important action needed to extend the life of your car’s paintwork. Paintwork is constantly under attack from various environmental factors and needs protection.

It is best to apply wax in a shaded area.

Make sure the paint surface is clean. Use a specially formulated car shampoo that won’t strip away the protective wax layer.

Use a clean polish applicator or a Microfibre cloth that won’t scratch the surface.

Concentrate on one panel at a time. Use a small amount of wax. Over application can cause swirl marks and wax becomes difficult to remove.

Use a Quick Wax to detail your vehicle in-between regular washing. Use as a quick touch up to restore that showroom shine instantly. Ideal for removing fingerprints smudges and dust.

Not for use on dirty cars.
